metadata.title: Enable-OpenSshPSRemoting
metadata.description:
Works on Windows 10 or Windows Server 2019, 2022, 2025 and assumes powershell 7 is already installed. 
On earlier OS please install OpenSSH & Powershell 7 
    choco install pwsh openssh

As default the script will Comment out `Match Group administrators` from `C:/ProgramData/ssh/sshd_config`. 
For some reason if not you can login as anyon in the  administrator group with your SSH key. 
See https://github.com/PowerShell/Win32-OpenSSH/issues/1324#issuecomment-519199468

If you choose not to comment this out and use the shared key functionality, you must 
remove Authenticated Users (S-1-5-11) permissions from `C:/ProgramData/ssh/administrators_authorized_keys`
